youtube_title: Minimum Balance Charge Made Your Balance Negative? RBI Says It Can't. Rules You Didn't Know #13 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #13. Only Rs 200 in the account, a minimum balance charge gets cut and now the balance shows minus. Can the bank do that? A: yes. B: no way.
Answer: B. RBI circular of 20 Nov 2014 on minimum balance penal charges: the savings account balance must not turn negative only because of minimum balance charges. Before charging, the bank must notify you by SMS, email or letter and give you at least one month to restore the balance, and the charge must be proportionate to the shortfall. If the bank won't fix it, complain to the RBI Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in.
Education only, not financial advice.
Source: RBI circular DBR.Dir.BC.No.47/13.03.00/2014-15, 20 Nov 2014.

Account mein bas ₹200 the, minimum balance ka charge kata aur balance MINUS mein? 😤
A: haan, bank kar sakta hai. B: bilkul nahi.
Sahi hai B ✅ RBI ka 2014 rule: sirf minimum balance charge ki wajah se balance negative nahi ho sakta. Charge se pehle bank ko SMS/email se batana padega aur balance bharne ke liye kam se kam 1 mahina dena hoga. Charge bhi kami ke hisaab se.
Bank na maane? RBI Ombudsman (cms.rbi.org.in) pe complaint.
